LanguageData.KCJ_MonumentRefreshEffect.label: Empty Fort — Propaganda
LanguageData.KCJ_MonumentRefreshEffect.description: After selecting this effect for a ritual in "Edit Ideogram", when the ritual ends with a quality of "Good" or above, there is an adjustable chance (default 100%) to generate a new monument construction quest — propaganda at its finest, making the patron favor you even more.
